title: Enhancing Group Recommendation with Memory-Augmented Reasoning in LLM Agent
abstract: arXiv:2608.21939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The core challenge in group recommendation lies in modeling the dynamic evolution of user preferences and explain?ing the consensus formation process. Existing Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods, despite improved interpretability, treat interaction history as fixed text, ignoring the natural evolution of group/user preferences over time, and lacking explicit modeling of the complex group decision-making process. To address these issues, we propose AGR, a LLM-based agent, which consists of a Memory Module and a Reasoning Module. The Memory Module employs a token-based hash table to dynamically manage the historical interactions of groups and users. This design supports fundamental operations including insertion, updating, retrieval, forgetting of irrelevant records, and summarization of evolving group and user profiles for efficiently tracking. translated_title: 增强基于LLM代理的记忆增强推理的群体推荐
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21939v1 公告类型：新 摘要：群体推荐的核心挑战在于建模用户偏好的动态演变并解释共识形成过程。现有的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法，尽管提高了可解释性，但将交互历史视为固定文本，忽略了群体/用户偏好随时间的自然演变，并且缺乏对复杂群体决策过程的显式建模。为解决这些问题，我们提出了AGR，一个基于LLM的代理，它由记忆模块和推理模块组成。记忆模块采用基于令牌的哈希表动态管理群体和用户的历史交互。这种设计支持基本操作，包括插入、更新、检索、遗忘不相关记录，以及总结演变的群体和用户档案，以实现高效跟踪。基于这些检索到的动态档案，推理模块随后执行多步骤推理。
tldr: 本文提出AGR，一个结合记忆模块和推理模块的LLM代理，通过动态管理历史交互和显式建模群体决策过程，解决了群体推荐中偏好演变和共识形成的关键挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AGR, an LLM-based agent with a memory module and reasoning module, which addresses the challenges of preference evolution and consensus formation in group recommendation by dynamically managing historical interactions and explicitly modeling the group decision-making process.
